window_policy.target: Whether the supplied activity tag at the window endpoint is 1-5 (fall); 6-11 are non-fall.
window_policy.unknown_labels: Exclude any labelled training/evaluation window containing a tag outside 1-11.
window_policy.timing: Use original elapsed timestamps. Do not resample, interpolate, or cross recording boundaries.

score_note: Sigmoid of the SVM decision margin, for display only. NOT a calibrated fall probability; scores are not directly comparable across algorithms.

plan.scaler: StandardScaler fit on training subjects only
plan.selection: Validation F2, then precision, smaller C, earlier gamma candidate, higher score threshold.
plan.score_transform: sigmoid(decision_function); display score only, NOT calibrated probability
plan.comparison_status: Exploratory comparison on previously inspected subjects 5-6. Not a new independent final test.
